demo.cliff: an education's own Events win over the shared table
teaches: Linked as Pre-Career Events, it is the event roll of an education that prints no Events of its own: 2d6, each row applied as a career's own Events row is, and row 7 sends on to the Life Events table.
A failure to graduate is a prohibition on graduation, scoped to the education: row 2 always leaves one, row 3 only when its INT 8+ throw fails, and the graduation roll is then not made.
A DM on the graduation roll is a dm entry on graduation, spent by that roll: row 8 holds DM+1, and row 11 DM+2 on a pass of its own throw or DM-1 on a failure.
Row 9 names a career with careerMode offer: the Reach Guard is offered at its next qualification, and taking the offer enters it with no roll.
Row 12 scopes its DM firstAfterGraduation: it outlives the education's close and is spent by the next qualification roll, whichever career that roll is for.
The rest are what any table row gives: a Contact on rows 2 and 12, a Rival on rows 3 and 4, one of two skills on row 5, and on row 6 a level in a skill the Traveller already holds.
demo.trap: Linking it changes nothing for Demo — Harbour Cadet School or Demo — Harbour University: an education whose eventTable holds rows rolls its own, so both keep their eleven rows whether this table is linked or not. It answers only an education with an empty eventTable, or a row whose subTable names Pre-Career Event; unlinked, such an education's event prints a sentence. Through row 7, Life Events and the Unusual Event are followed in turn, and so is a sub-table the Unusual Event names. Row 12's DM bears on the first qualification roll after the education, refused or not; where that first career is entered with no roll, the DM is bound to it by name and waits there. Everything but eventTable is inert on a table, and the eleven record fields below it stay empty, as on every template.

system.description: What happens to a Bellweather student between the lectures and the boat trials, for an education that prints no Events of its own. Invented for this pack, and no book's table.

eventTable.text: The spring tide breaks the river wall in your final year, and you spend it on the sandbag lines in the lower town. You fail to graduate, but gain a Contact among the flood crews.

tray.note: The flood year: no graduation roll in this education, and its fail arm still runs.

eventTable.text: An examiner says your chart work was copied from another student's. Throw INT 8+ to clear your name; fail, and you gain a Rival and fail to graduate.

tray.note: Not cleared: no graduation roll in this education.

eventTable.text: You run the student paper and print what a shipping heir would rather you had not. Gain a Rival.
You spend the long vacation on a fen farm, mending pumps and moving stock. Gain one level of Mechanic or Animals.
You give the dark months to one thing you already know. Raise one skill you hold by a level.
Something at home takes a year from your books. Roll on the Life Events table.
An old Guild pilot lends you her own channel charts for the year. DM+1 on your graduation roll.

tray.note: The pilot's charts: DM+1 on this education's graduation roll, spent by it.

eventTable.text: A Reach Guard officer lectures at the school and remembers your work. The Reach Guard is offered to you, with no qualification roll.
The harbour board's archive takes you on to sort its old survey logs. EDU +1.
You sit the Guild's entrance paper a year early. Throw EDU 8+: pass, and DM+2 on your graduation roll; fail, and DM-1.

tray.note: The early paper passed: DM+2 on this education's graduation roll.
The early paper failed: DM-1 on this education's graduation roll.

eventTable.text: A shipping house pays for your last year and wants you back when you finish. Gain a Contact there, and DM+1 on the qualification roll of the first career you try after this education.

tray.note: The shipping house: DM+1 on the first qualification roll after the education, whichever career it is for.
